run_finetune_training: run finetune training on F5-TTS v1 Base model with a custom dataset and learning rate
run_e2_tts_training: run E2-TTS Base model training with UNetT transformer and custom dataset
run_training_with_wandb: run TTS model training with wandb or tensorboard logger for experiment tracking
run_custom_tokenizer_training: run TTS training with a custom tokenizer vocab file for specialized text encoding
run_batch_size_config: run TTS training with configurable batch size type frame or sample and per-gpu batch size
